# Hobson AI

> Hobson AI is an AI co-worker built for property. It reads your property documents — leases, licences, certificates, management agreements — and turns them into structured, evidence-backed answers. Every answer links to the exact clause and page it came from.

Hobson organises everything around a simple hierarchy: Portfolio > Unit Group > Unit. You ask a question in plain English; Hobson prepares the information and the evidence, and you make the decision.

## Solutions

- [Lease management software](https://hobsonschoice.ai/lease-management-software): Track lease events, dates and obligations with evidence from the original documents.
- [Property management software](https://hobsonschoice.ai/property-management-software): AI software for property teams managing documents, units and compliance.
- [Property portfolio software](https://hobsonschoice.ai/property-portfolio-software): Portfolio-wide answers across unit groups and units.
- [AI lease abstraction](https://hobsonschoice.ai/ai-lease-abstraction): Automated extraction of lease terms into structured property knowledge.
